images.filename: Golestan Palace, Tehran, Iran (53758596870).jpg
images.caption:
The Golestan Palace was built in the 16th century.  It is the former official royal Qajar complex in Tehran.

The Palace is one of the oldest historic monuments in the city of Tehran, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It consists of gardens, royal buildings, and collections of Iranian crafts and European presents from the 18th and 19th centuries. (Wikipedia)
images.alt:
